purpose: Execute the atomic create-parameterized-planar-profile operation within the MA-04 boundary: One planar profile construction. It does not extrude, sweep, loft, attach, save, or select a target face.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-parameterized-planar-profile and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: plane
inputs.description: The plane on which the profile is defined.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: Selects exactly one supported profile branch.

inputs.name: center_uv_mm
inputs.description: In-plane UV centre in millimetres; required for rectangle and circle branches.

inputs.name: angle_deg
inputs.description: Finite in-plane angle in degrees; required for rectangle and circle branches.

inputs.name: width_mm
inputs.description: Rectangle width in millimetres; required for the rectangle branch.

inputs.name: height_mm
inputs.description: Rectangle height in millimetres; required for the rectangle branch.

inputs.name: radius_mm
inputs.description: Circle radius in millimetres; required for the circle branch.

inputs.name: vertices_mm
inputs.description: At least three finite 3-D vertices in millimetres; required for the polygon branch and checked against the supplied plane.

preconditions: plane is valid and kind is rectangle, circle, or polygon.
Rectangle/circle branch dimensions are finite and positive; centre has two coordinates and angle is finite.

Polygon branch has at least three vertices, every vertex lies on the supplied plane within the coded tolerance, has nonzero signed area, has no repeated adjacent vertices, and has no detected self-intersection or nonadjacent touching.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A RectangleProfile, CircleProfile, or generic Profile depending on kind; no body is created or attached.

postconditions: The selected profile constructor returns a profile reference.
The polygon branch constructs one closed CurveSegment loop and passes it to Profile.
